# Project 16: Project Management Command Center

**Category:** 2. Business, Strategy & Operations
**Status:** Pending. Not started; work begins only on the explicit command `Start Project 16`.

## Brief (from the source PDF)

Keeps projects, deadlines, blockers and team updates in one view.

> Original: Projects, deadlines, blockers aur team updates ko ek view mein rakhta hai.

### Core features

- Kanban board
- Timeline
- Risk log
- Status reports
